test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 09 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: Fats and oils get reduced over time and smell bad.
Fats and oils are oxidised, they become rancid.
Antioxidants are added to foods containing fats and oil to prevent oxidation.
Chips manufacturers usually flush bags of chips with Nitrogen to prevent the chips from getting rancid.

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The statement that is incorrect is "Fats and oils get reduced over time and smell bad".
